propositions: Plan-review attestations must record signed material fingerprints for direct children and prerequisites so that downstream reviews invalidate when related plan material drifts.

New attestations emit pin records in deterministic manifest order before signing; legacy unpinned attestations remain valid and older readers ignore additive pin lines without corrupting signature verification.

A plan_review_phase reducer projection (planning or execution) is maintained across compaction and STATUS transitions; entry to in_progress sets execution, entry to open resets planning, and execution reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority-floor threshold.

Pin validity is enforced by all seven named consumers (claim, close, reuse, drift refresh, re-sign, audit, health) when enforce_plan_material_pins=true; disabled enforcement reports drift as advisory without invalidating attestations.

Close operations require a current certified plan review (phase-compatible, material current, pins current) only when require_plan_review_for_close=true; code freshness does not invalidate the close-gate review.

Prerequisite consistency evaluation receives subject plan and current narrow material of each canonical prerequisite and returns one deterministic three-disposition coverage record per prerequisite; any indeterminate coverage record yields unsigned INDETERMINATE attestation.
